scope: Bounded source-clause decomposition of references 1.11–1.21, checked visually on specification PDF page 18 / printed 12. Original teaching evidence and unresolved assessment checks remain partial.
identifierPolicy: Requirement suffixes r1, r2, etc. are local editorial audit identifiers; only the parent reference is publisher-numbered.

parents.scopeNote: The source's changes of speed, shape and direction are illustrative examples, not three separately numbered obligations.

requirements.summary: Describe how forces between bodies can change their motion or shape.
remainingChecks: Check independent explanations of shape change with balanced external forces and direction change at constant speed.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Gravitational and electrostatic forces are source examples; broader force names support identification rather than add official subnumbers.

requirements.summary: Identify force types from the interacting bodies.
remainingChecks: Calibrate unfamiliar contact/non-contact scenarios without treating electrostatic attraction as proof of net charge.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: The distinction requires direction as well as magnitude for vectors; examples remain original teaching content.

requirements.summary: Distinguish scalar quantities from vector quantities.
remainingChecks: Independently assess scalar/vector classification and same-speed direction changes.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: One force-vector demand is retained as one local requirement.

requirements.summary: Explain why a force needs magnitude and direction.
remainingChecks: Calibrate complete vector answers and direction-only versus magnitude-only partial responses.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: The source restricts this calculation to a line; no two-dimensional component requirement is inferred.

requirements.summary: Calculate a resultant of collinear forces.
remainingChecks: The experimental force family remains provisional; calibrate diagram-reading, inverse and three-force adaptations before promotion.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: The source gives the elementary opposing-motion statement; relative sliding is an original clarification preventing an overgeneralised friction rule.

requirements.summary: Identify friction as a force opposing motion in the relevant contact situation.
remainingChecks: Calibrate identification of the body, contact and relative sliding direction in unfamiliar examples.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Know and use are distinct source demands; inverse forms and zero-acceleration caveats support accurate application.

requirements.summary: Know the relationship between resultant force, mass and acceleration.
remainingChecks: Independent recall and identification of resultant rather than individual applied force remain unvalidated.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use F = ma with the relevant resultant and consistent units.
remainingChecks: Calibrate inverse choices, gram conversion, zero-acceleration cases and linked method/error-carried-forward marking.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Know and use are retained separately. The question's stated gravitational field strength controls numerical work.

requirements.summary: Know how weight relates to mass and gravitational field strength.
remainingChecks: Independently assess weight versus mass and N/kg versus m/s² in their respective contexts.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use W = mg and its rearrangements.
remainingChecks: Calibrate inverse g and mass calculations and unit-conversion cases.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Thinking and braking distances are parts of one sum relationship, not two additional official reference numbers.

requirements.summary: Recognise stopping distance as thinking distance plus braking distance.
remainingChecks: Calibrate matching each distance to its interval and distinguishing stopping time from stopping distance.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: All four factors follow 'including' in the specification and are separately tracked. Fixed-force and fixed-deceleration qualifications are original modelling support.

requirements.summary: Describe how initial speed affects stopping distance.
remainingChecks: Independently assess linear thinking-distance versus quadratic braking-distance comparisons under the stated assumptions.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe how mass affects stopping distance.
remainingChecks: Calibrate reasoning for fixed braking force versus a changed available friction force; do not assume one universal mass scaling.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe how road condition affects stopping distance.
remainingChecks: Calibrate complete causal chains from available friction to deceleration to braking distance.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe how reaction time affects stopping distance.
remainingChecks: Assess thinking-distance changes independently while holding braking conditions fixed.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Describing forces and explaining attainment of terminal velocity are separately tracked; buoyancy and vacuum notes clarify the model.

requirements.summary: Describe forces acting on a falling object.
remainingChecks: Calibrate labelled force diagrams, resultant directions and the limits of the weight/drag-only model.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Explain why a falling object can reach terminal velocity.
remainingChecks: Calibrate the speed-drag-resultant-acceleration chain, including a parachute opening without an instantaneous direction reversal.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.
